chat: How did Anshuman pull out the big weed?
options: He pulled it out slowly and careful.
He pull it out slowly and carefully.
He pulled it out slowly and carefully.

Yes, I did. We walked around the whole farm.

After the hard work, Anshuman and his father returned home along the narrow path.
